issue.title: str argument is mistaken as a dict if it looks like 'Foo:'

summary.text: The original bug reproduced and the fix changes yaml_load's return type as intended with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found a counterexample: yaml_load(stream='on:') raises TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'bool' and 'str'. Look next at how the fix rebuilds the string when the parsed key is not a str (YAML parses 'on' as a boolean), and note that no test guards the reproduc…

property.name: word_colon_is_string
property.claim: A string that looks like 'Foo:' (a single name followed by a colon) is not turned into a dict {'Foo': None}. It is returned as the original string.
property.quote: str argument is mistaken as a dict if it looks like 'Foo:'

findings.relation: new with the fix: before it, this input returns {True: None}

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue reports that the str value 'Foo:' is wrongly parsed as {'Foo': None}; returning the string 'Foo:' is exactly the requested behaviour.

survivors.original: elif len(value) == 1 and list(value.values())[0] is None:
survivors.replacement: elif len(value) >= 1 and list(value.values())[0] is None:
survivors.description: Loosens the single-key check so multi-key dicts enter the branch.
survivors.diff:
--- a/jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py
+++ b/jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py
@@ -63,3 +63,3 @@
         # Handle special case: strings ending with ':' like 'Foo:' which YAML parses as {'Foo': None}
-        elif len(value) == 1 and list(value.values())[0] is None:
+        elif len(value) >= 1 and list(value.values())[0] is None:
             key = list(value.keys())[0]
survivors.words: jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py:64: changing `        elif len(value) == 1 and list(value.values())[0] is ...` to `        elif len(value) >= 1 and list(value.values())[0] is ...` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)

survivors.description: Drops strip, so 'Foo:' with surrounding whitespace is parsed as a dict.
survivors.diff:
--- a/jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py
+++ b/jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py
@@ -66,3 +66,3 @@
             # Check if original stream is like 'key:' which YAML would parse as {key: None}
-            if stream.strip() == key + ':':
+            if stream == key + ':':
                 value = stream
survivors.words: jsonargparse/loaders_dumpers.py:67: changing `            if stream.strip() == key + ':':` to `            if stream == key + ':':` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)
